tools.name: find_recipe
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a recipe link and you only need to know whether Only Recipes already has it. Returns the matching recipe's id, name and page, or exists: false. Fetches nothing. To show the recipe, use import_recipe instead.

tools.description: Use this when you need valid tag slugs for search_recipes, for example to filter by cuisine, course, diet or occasion.
